title: Acceleration time and distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time (5 s) and distance (75 m) for the police car to accelerate from its initial speed to match the truck's speed.

title: Maximum relative distance
description: Important: Correctly determines the maximum distance (50 m) between the front of the police car and the rear of the truck when their speeds first become equal.

title: Total overtaking displacement
description: Important: Correctly identifies the total required displacement (78 m) that the police car's front must gain relative to the truck's rear to achieve the safe configuration.

title: Three-phase motion analysis
description: Important: Models the police car's motion correctly as acceleration, possible constant speed, and deceleration phases to meet the safe distance condition.

title: Reaction time adjustment
description: Important: Correctly adjusts initial conditions (e.g., separation becomes 45 m) and timing to account for the 2-second reaction delay in part (4).

title: Speed limit constraint
description: Important: Correctly incorporates the 30 m/s maximum speed limit into the three-phase motion analysis for part (5).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all speeds (km/h to m/s) correctly and maintains consistent units throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in relative motion
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign (e.g., relative speed or displacement) when calculating relative positions or the overtaking condition.

title: Omits safe distance geometry
description: Pitfall: Fails to include the lengths of both vehicles (5 m + 20 m) when calculating the required 53 m 'ahead' condition, leading to an incorrect Δx₂.
